title: cubacle common definitions
description: Shared building blocks of the cubacle JSON schemas, version 1. Only referenced by the other schema files, never used on its own.

formatVersion.description: Format version. Always 1 in this schema family.

name.description: Pattern id: lowercase a-z, 0-9 and '-', starting with a letter or digit.

aliases.description: Other pattern ids for the same pattern.

size.description: Cube size N for an N x N x N cube, 2 to 7.

sizes.description: One size or a non-empty list of sizes.

token.description: One sticker of the schema grid. A lowercase letter with an optional number is a placeholder that may take any color (a, b1). A single uppercase letter is a fixed color read through the color scheme. '.' and '?' are don't care.

row.description: One row of stickers of a face.

face.description: One face: N rows of N tokens. The count per face is checked against the size by the reader, as in the text form.

faceGrid.description: The schema grid: faces in the order U R F D L B, each a list of rows, each a list of tokens. An error path /schema/2/3 means face index 2, row index 3. One face is allowed when the same face pattern applies to all six.

guard.description: The guard as a string in the guard grammar of the text form. Functions: unique(...), equal(...), count(...), symmetric(TYPE), antisymmetric(TYPE), order(...). Operators: ! NOT, == != < <= > >=, && AND and, || OR or. A '*' after a variable letter stands for the same index in all arguments of the term. The reader parses and checks the string; this schema only restricts the characters.

hexColor.description: Display color as #RGB or #RRGGBB, hex digits in either case. #RGB expands to #RRGGBB by doubling each digit.

schemeLetters.description: Six distinct uppercase letters for U R F D L B. Distinctness is checked by the reader.

schemeName.description: A built-in scheme name or the name of a scheme file.

colorLetters.description: Display color for each color code, as #RGB or #RRGGBB. Every code must occur in the scheme letters; the reader checks this.

colorScheme.description: A color scheme: a built-in name, a scheme file name, or six inline letters.

orbit.description: An orbit of pieces of the cube. The list follows the names the implementation uses.

symmetryType.description: A Schoenflies name such as D4h. The valid names are the 33 conjugacy classes of subgroups of the cube symmetry group, derived by the implementation; the reader reports unknown names.

order.description: Order of the generating move sequence: a number, a range {min, max} or a set.

metric.description: Move metric of a found sequence.

status.description: How well a found sequence is established.

alphabet.description: Moves used by the move search: outer, slices, blocks, or an explicit list of moves.

limits.description: Default limits of the generator. Text keys state-limit, max-states, max-time-ms, max-memory-mb and max-depth. The command line or the request overrides them.

errorInfo.description: An error. The text form fills line and column, the JSON form fills path (a JSON pointer such as /schema/2/3). Both give a message and, when known, what was expected.
